title: Remo
tagline: Remo is a "AI Personal Assistant" who can be hired by every human on planet. How about reminding you what to do, buy a stock/coin when you are enjoying your vacation, with an unimaginable trust. It's time for everyone to have their own assistant not just the rich!
description:
Remo is a Personal AI Assistant that can be hired by every human in the planet. Personal Assistant is not only for Rich! Remo helps make users' lives easier. It's a sophisticated personal AI assistant powered by Privy for auth and wallet creation, Viem for Blockchain interactions on sepolia and Base, AWS Bedrock (Claude 3 Sonnet) with multi-agent collaboration capabilities.

Nevertheless this is just Version 1.0 project born in Agentic Ethereum 2025 who can make Real time blockchain interactions, Save contacts (Name : Wallet address), Create unlimited wallets, uses AWS Bedrock with Multi-Agent Orchestration and give suggestions for Books and travel using it's Knowledge Base(RAG), can save your tasks/to-do lists. Other than the webpage user can also integrate Telegram and chat with remo. No need of remembering your keys Remo can now fetch them from AWS dynomoDB easily without revealing them!

Please NOTE: This is version 1.0 there are some areas we need to update it.
how_its_made:
This project uses typescript, React, vite, telegram bot and partner technologies Privy, AWS Bedrock, Base and users can deploy using Autonome as well.

Privy: Used this to create better authentication and wallet creation. It has been a bigger headache to create and manage user authentication creating frontend to storing them securely and Privy made sure all this in a single step juts a page of code and it's done!

AWS Bedrock: Used this for LLM inference, created multi-Agent collaboration between different agents using different  knowledge bases(RAG). These things have never been easy "api calls between the agents" and using aws bedrock it's done in couple of minutes and can use multiple types of top LLM's.

Viem: This is one such a beautiful master piece, people say a Legend build it haha. Agents with a wallet and more. Blockchain interactions with ai agent is very easy using viem. I probably think we should have a bounty for using viem as well, not because i used it rather it's such a master piece.

Autonome: Rather than cloning repository and creating the agent, we have deployed it on autonome now users can create their agent and monitor it there.

Hacky that's notable and worth mentioning -> 
1. creating personalized contacts( name: wallet) like traditional phone contacts.
2. Agent creating, storing, managing wallet for user and story safely by encrypting: Agents should learn to create wallets so that it makes new users who are new to blockchain can easily use it.
